name: vectfox-tests
description: Automated tests for VectFox RAG extension

scripts.test: eslint . && knip && knip --production && npm run check:duplicates && npm run check:imports && vitest run
scripts.check:imports: npm run check:import-graph && npm run check:named-exports && npm run check:host-imports
scripts.check:duplicates: jscpd index.js backends core diagnostics Migration providers ui utils --format javascript --min-tokens 50 --ignore "**/vendor/**" --baseline .jscpd-baseline.json --fail-on-new-clones --silent
scripts.list:duplicates: jscpd index.js backends core diagnostics Migration providers ui utils --format javascript --min-tokens 50 --ignore "**/vendor/**"
